title: Trays & organisers
description: Trays and organisers sized around their contents. For minibars, desks and carefully considered service.

body.html: Trays and organisers sized around their contents. For minibars, desks and carefully considered service.

media.alt: Overhead tabletop collection of coasters, trays and placemats in olive, taupe and cognac.

body.html: A made-to-measure tray brings together the objects that belong together in daily use. From a coffee machine to a welcome gift, we develop the shape and compartments around your contents. Timber and covered constructions offer different possibilities; materials and branding are agreed for the selected build. Even a single tray can become a bespoke development, handmade in the EU.
For minibars, desks or the presentation of guest amenities. Custom dimensions and compartments give the items you actually use a considered place.

media.alt: SFP tray with a cup and compartmented organiser — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.
Find individual models, material choices and specification options in our complete accessory collection.
